title: Drawing scope extraction candidates
description: Shape of the candidates file the agent writes while reading a drawing set and the coverage ledger that proves which sheets and probes were reviewed. scripts/scope_list.py reads this file and prints the scope list.

set_name.description: Project and set as printed on the cover sheet, for example 'Suite 300 Tenant Improvement, Permit Set 2026-08-14'.

sheet_count.description: Number of sheets in the inventory. Must equal the number of kind: sheet entries in coverage_ledger.

division.description: Two-digit MasterFormat division from references/csi-divisions.md. Reserved divisions are not allowed.

candidate.description: The work item only: product, assembly, or activity with its location when the drawings give one. No sheet numbers, division names, or cost codes here.

sheet_number.description: Primary sheet the candidate is taken from. Must match a kind: sheet entry in coverage_ledger.

related_sheets.description: Other sheets that show the same item.

location.description: Where on the sheet: keyed note number, schedule row, detail number, partition type, legend entry, general note.

quote.description: Short verbatim text from the sheet that supports the candidate. Mark OCR-derived text as such.

support_level.description: How the sheet supports the item. See references/grounding-rules.md. reference_only, by_others, and inferred candidates can never be decision: include.

spec_section.description: Specification section number when support_level is spec_requirement.

reason.description: Why the decision and division were chosen. Required to be non-empty for exclude and review; record judgment calls for include.

notes.description: Anything the estimator should see next to the item on the scope list, for example a division judgment call.

cost_code.description: Only when the user supplied a cost code list and asked for a mapping. Never invented.

assumptions.description: Readings of the drawings the user should confirm. Not candidates.

exclusions.description: Blanket exclusions stated on the drawings (NIC, by tenant, by landlord) that are not tied to a single candidate. Item-level by-others work is recorded as a candidate with support_level by_others and decision exclude.

rfis.description: Questions the documents cannot answer. Not candidates.

coverage_ledger.description: One entry per sheet in the inventory, one per probe run, and one per notable source (schedule, general-note list) whose treatment is not obvious from the candidates. Built from the sheets and probes first, never generated backward from the candidate list.

source.description: Sheet number as printed in the title block.

title.description: Sheet title from the sheet index or title block.

reason.description: What the sheet contributed, or why it could not be reviewed.
What concrete items the probe surfaced and what happened to each, or that it surfaced nothing.

source.description: A schedule, general-note list, or blanket requirement, named with its sheet.
Sheet and location the note is grounded in, or 'not stated in the set' for a gap.
